translations.web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
translations.bsb: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
translations.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
translations.asv: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.
